## TURN 1 — FOUNDATION SEARCH RESULTS & PRELIMINARY ROSTER

I've executed 4 searches (3 used my allocation, 1 was blocked). Here's what I found and the preliminary roster I've built.

---

### KEY FINDINGS FROM SEARCHES

**PDP8 Framework (Decision 500/2023, amended by Decision 768/2025, Implementation Plan Decision 262/2024 & Decision 1509/2025):**

Total capacity targets to 2030: domestic gas 14,930 MW; LNG 22,400 MW; coal 30,127 MW; cogeneration/waste-heat 2,700 MW.

Of 13 LNG projects (22,400 MW), only 3 projects/2,824 MW were under construction on schedule (Nhơn Trạch 3&4, Hiệp Phước). Others face PPA/GSA delays.

Vietnam will not build new coal plants after 2030, and no new gas plants after 2035, per PDP8.

Nhơn Trạch 3 & 4 (PV Power) have entered commercial operation — Vietnam's first LNG-fired plants, with combined capacity of 1.6 GW.

Nine domestic gas projects identified: Ô Môn I (660 MW), Ô Môn II–IV (3×1,050 MW), Dung Quất I–III (3×750 MW), Miền Trung I (capacity cut off in text).

Quảng Trạch II approved as LNG plant (converted from coal), 1,500 MW (2×750 MW CCGT), developed by EVN in Quảng Bình.

Vũng Áng 2 — 1,200 MW coal in Hà Tĩnh, developed by Mitsubishi/KEPCO consortium.

Quảng Trạch 1 — 1,200 MW coal in Quảng Bình, under construction by EVN.

Vân Phong power station is operating, at least 1,432 MW in Khánh Hòa (Sumitomo BOT).

Na Dương 1 — 100 MW coal, owned by Vinacomin, operational since 2005.

Duyên Hải I & III — 2,488 MW coal in Trà Vinh, commissioned 2016, developed by EVN.

Vĩnh Tân IV — 1,800 MW coal in Bình Thuận.

Duyên Hải II — 1,320 MW coal BOT in Trà Vinh, COD 2021, developed by Teknik Janakuasa.

Vĩnh Tân II — 1,244 MW coal in Bình Thuận, operating since 2014, EVN/Evngenco 3.

---
